abstract:
<jats:p>
                    Halide solid electrolytes (SEs) show high ionic conductivity and good compatibility with cathode active materials, providing long‐life all‐solid‐state lithium‐ion batteries (ASSLIBs). Liquid‐phase synthesis technology is a feasible option for the large‐scale manufacturing of halide SEs. However, no leading liquid‐phase synthesis method for halide SEs has been developed because of a limited understanding of the solvent effect on the formation of halide SEs.
